response.sql: WITH funding_summary AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL') AS fundflux, COUNT(sq.qualregistry) AS fund_count FROM scanqc sq INNER JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'NULL')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(fund_count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as distinct_funding_sources FROM funding_summary) SELECT fs.fundflux, fs.fund_count AS count, fs.fund_count * 1.0 / t.total_count AS fraction, fs.fund_count * 1.0 / (t.total_count * 1.0 / t.distinct_funding_sources) AS ratio_to_average FROM funding_summary fs CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY fs.fund_count DESC
